bull.b: Revenue has scaled from $385.7M in 2024 to $776.6M TTM, while Q2 net product revenue grew 46% year over year. This expanding commercial base, led by AUVELITY, SUNOSI and SYMBRAVO, provides a stronger platform for future operating leverage.

bull.t: Broad payer access and prescription traction
bull.b: AUVELITY reached about 89% coverage of total lives, while SUNOSI maintained 82% coverage and SYMBRAVO reached 57%. Broadening reimbursement and rising prescriptions can support durable patient access, reduce friction in adoption, and extend the commercial runway of the marketed portfolio.

FDA acceptance of the AXS-12 NDA, multiple Phase III programs, and a plan to file roughly one NDA annually through 2030 give Axsome several potential growth paths. This diversified CNS pipeline can broaden revenue beyond current products if trials and reviews succeed.

bear.b: TTM EBIT margin is about -24% and net margin about -25%, while Q2 net loss widened to $51.3M. Persistent losses show commercial scale has not yet translated into sustainable profitability, limiting internally funded investment and resilience if growth moderates.

TTM operating cash flow and free cash flow were approximately negative $71M, and quarterly cash burn remained about $24M-$25M. Although burn is improving, continued consumption means Axsome must reach cash-flow positivity to reduce reliance on financing.

Total debt of $219.2M compares with only $83.3M of equity, producing debt-to-equity of about 2.63. This capital structure leaves less financial flexibility while losses persist and increases the importance of achieving the company’s projected cash-flow improvement.
